title: collected-evidence
description: Written by the controller/collector after a worker finishes. Validated before allowing any state advance. The worker's prose is one evidence item; the collector independently calculates changed paths, diff summary, commit identity, and check exit codes.

schema_version.description: Schema version; always 1 for this version of the collected evidence

run_id.description: Run identifier from the dispatched envelope. Format: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-slug.

status.description: AAW lifecycle status from §10. Terminal states are completed, failed, cancelled. 'review' is the correct value (not 'review_required' — the §9.3 example uses a non-canonical name). 'blocked' is valid but non-terminal. 'done', 'idle', 'unknown' are Herdr observations, not AAW states.

agent.description: Worker identity as reported by the execution manager (e.g. herdr).

provider.description: AI provider/CLI that executed the task

native_session_id.description: Native session ID as reported by the Herdr integration

git.description: Git state computed independently by the collector — not trusted from worker prose.

worktree.description: Absolute path to the git worktree where the task executed

base_sha.description: Full 40-character SHA of the base commit. Abbreviated SHAs must fail.

head_sha.description: Full 40-character SHA of HEAD after the task. Abbreviated SHAs must fail.

dirty.description: True if the worktree has uncommitted changes; false if clean

changed_paths.description: Paths modified in this run, computed from git diff by the collector

checks.description: Test/verification commands run by the collector. Each entry records command, exit code, and output digest.

command.description: The test or verification command that was run

exit_code.description: Exit code of the command; 0 typically means pass

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the command output for integrity tracking

policy.description: Policy gate outcomes. All three gates are required — a missing gate must fail validation, not default to true.

path_scope_passed.description: True if all modified paths were within allowed_paths; false if any forbidden or out-of-scope paths were touched

tests_passed.description: True if all required acceptance checks passed (exit code 0); false otherwise

independent_review_passed.description: True if an independent review (human or second agent) approved the result; false if review is pending or rejected

agent_summary.description: Worker-supplied prose summary. This is ONE evidence item and is NOT trusted — the collector independently computes changed paths, diff summary, commit identity, and check exit codes. Documented here because JSON Schema cannot encode trust boundaries; consumers must treat this as untrusted self-report.

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the collector wrote this result
